system.description:
You exhale a powerful stream of wind from your mouth. Creatures caught in the target area must make a Strength Saving throw. Creatures take 2d8 Wind damage and fall knocked Prone on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

Also, vapors, mists, gases and fogs that can be dispersed by strong winds are dispelled immediately.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, creatures who fail their saving throw also gain +1 rank of Bleed. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, the size of this jutsu’s cone increases by +20 feet. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher this jutsu gains the Clash keyword and creatures who fail their saving throw are pushed backwards 20 feet. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, the size of this jutsu’s cone increases by +20 feet.
